title: HealthQA-BR: A System-Wide Benchmark Reveals Critical Knowledge Gaps in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot accuracy of large language models on multiple-choice questions across diverse healthcare disciplines, measuring the performance gap between specialized, physician-centric fields (e.g., Ophthalmology) and community-focused, allied health professions (e.g., Social Work, Nursing).

Evaluating models using a Portuguese-language dataset sourced specifically from Brazil's national licensing and residency exams to counter the English-language and high-resource geographical myopia prevalent in existing medical benchmarks.
